title: GraphCert: Bootstrap Agentic Graph Reasoning with Certified Evidence Rubrics
abstract: arXiv:2609.38798v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Graph agents extend large language models (LLMs) with the ability to actively explore and reason over knowledge graphs through multi-step interactions with graph tools. However, training capable graph agents typically requires large collections of question-answer pairs and reasoning trajectories, whose manual construction is costly and difficult to scale. Moreover, employing proprietary LLMs to generate such supervision further risks exposing sensitive graph data to external services. Therefore, we propose GraphCert to bootstrap agentic graph reasoning with certified evidence rubrics during post-training. Specifically, the Bootstrapped Graph Quizzer guided by generation controls produces graph-grounded QA pairs and marks supporting evidence, which undergo execution certification and semantic curation. translated_title: GraphCert：基于认证证据量规的自举式智能体图推理
translated_abstract: 图智能体通过与大模型（LLMs）进行多步骤的图工具交互，扩展了大语言模型主动探索知识图谱并进行推理的能力。然而，训练能力强大的图智能体通常需要大量的问题-答案对和推理轨迹，而人工构建这些数据的成本高昂且难以规模化。此外，使用专有LLM生成此类监督数据还存在将敏感图数据暴露给外部服务的风险。因此，我们提出GraphCert，在后训练阶段通过认证证据量规来自举式地引导智能体图推理。具体而言，在生成控制的引导下，自举图测验生成器产生基于图的问答对并标注支持证据，这些证据经过执行认证和语义筛选。通过认证的证据随后被规范化为认证证据量规，用于在后续训练中奖励Graph Solver的证据对齐……
tldr: GraphCert提出在后训练阶段通过自举图测验生成器自动产生基于图的问答对与标注证据，经执行认证和语义筛选后形成认证证据量规，从而在无需昂贵人工标注、且避免敏感图数据暴露给外部专有LLM的情况下引导智能体图推理。
en_tdlr: GraphCert bootstraps agentic graph reasoning during post-training by automatically generating graph-grounded QA pairs with certified evidence rubrics through execution certification and semantic curation, avoiding costly manual annotation and the risk of exposing sensitive graph data to external proprietary LLMs.
